detailed_rationale:
Triveni Turbine is an established industrial heat-and-power solutions provider specializing in steam turbine systems up to 100 MW, serving power generation, cogeneration, biomass and waste-to-energy customers across steel, cement and chemicals, among others -- a genuine long-cycle industrial franchise rather than a recent entrant. The company is also investing in next-generation technologies (CO2-based heat pumps, Organic Rankine Cycle turbines), a real diversification of its addressable market beyond conventional steam turbines.

Q4 FY26 (March-2026 quarter) revenue rose to Rs 680 crore from Rs 538 crore a year earlier (~26% YoY), while net profit rose more modestly to Rs 102 crore from Rs 95 crore (~7% YoY) -- profit growth clearly lagging revenue growth, a mild margin-dilution signal in an otherwise strong quarter. This is consistent with the quant sheet's own scoring, where the 1-year composite (52.0) is notably weaker than the 3-year composite (71.0), and the value_score (~32) is among the lowest across this review batch, indicating the quant model itself already flags this as an expensive stock relative to its own history. Balance sheet is excellent (D/E ~0.02, interest coverage ~150x) and returns are strong (ROE ~25%, ROCE ~30%), consistent with a high-quality, long-established industrial compounder. Q1 FY27 results were pending at the time of this review (board meeting scheduled 10-Aug-2026).
recommendation_rationale: Quant already rates this Hold on both horizons (final scores 71.0/52.0); the business quality (debt-free, high ROCE, genuine long-cycle industrial franchise) is not in question, but the rich trailing valuation (quant PE ~57x, lowest value_score in this batch) combined with profit growth lagging revenue growth in the latest reported quarter argues against a rescue upgrade -- Hold is the appropriate, fully-priced-quality call.
summary: Triveni Turbine is a well-established, financially very strong maker of industrial steam turbines, now also investing in newer heat-pump and Organic Rankine Cycle technologies. Its most recent reported quarter showed solid revenue growth, but profit grew much more slowly, a sign that margins came under some pressure even in a good quarter. The stock is also priced richly relative to its own history. We rate it a Hold: a genuinely high-quality industrial name, but not a bargain.
positive_para: A debt-free balance sheet, ~150x interest coverage, and ROCE near 30% reflect a genuinely high-quality, long-established industrial franchise, and the move into CO2 heat pumps and Organic Rankine Cycle turbines is a credible extension of the company's core turbomachinery competency into new, energy-efficiency-linked addressable markets.
negative_para: Net profit grew only ~7% YoY in the most recently reported quarter against ~26% revenue growth -- a real margin-dilution signal, not a one-off anomaly to wave away -- and the stock's own quant value_score is among the lowest seen in this review batch, indicating it is already priced well ahead of many peers on a return-adjusted basis.
reverse_dcf_judgment: At a ~Rs 19,374-19,852 crore market cap and trailing PE near 57x against ROE of ~25%, the market is pricing sustained double-digit growth with stable-to-improving margins -- a bar the most recent quarter's profit performance (only ~7% YoY) did not clearly clear, even though revenue growth (~26%) did. Call: fair-to-rich; a high-quality compounder priced for more consistent margin performance than it just delivered.
research_sources: Triveni Turbine Ltd - Q4 FY26 results, business description - https://www.screener.in/company/TRITURBINE/consolidated/
technical_commentary: The 2021-2024 uptrend broke in a meaningful way: the March-2026 low (Rs440) undercut the prior correction low from Feb-2025 (Rs482), a genuine lower-low that invalidates the multi-year higher-low sequence, compounded by 2024's elevated volume into the eventual peak -- a mild distribution tell. The Apr-May 2026 rally (+68% in two months) is sharp but the MA stack is still unresolved (10m sits below 20m) -- an early, unconfirmed reversal attempt off a broken structure rather than a name back in trend.
